params.caption: 🎮 Ubisoft's new Creative House 2 chief wants to be "the A24 of video games" Industry veteran Christoph Hartmann, now general manager of Ubisoft's Creative House 2, told Variety his dream is to turn the unit into a games version of the film studio A24. He means titles that land with both critics and buyers, the way A24's Backrooms earned over $400 million on a reported $10 million budget this year. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 17:28 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @Ubisoft 🎬 Can Ubisoft pull it off?
